Claims Might Bows and Might Armors are exclusive Dragon wishes. The Might Bow part matches gf1/gf2/gf4, but Might Armor is not a wish (gf1-81-8, gf2-60-8, gf4-21-135) and drops from Fire/Flame Plates (gf3-23-1, ra-comments).
